leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a component with state to manage a dynamic list of items and a loading flag.
Implement a service method to fetch paginated data from an API.
Configure an event handler to detect when the user scrolls near the bottom of the page.
Integrate the scroll event handler with the data fetching service to load more items.
Update the component's template to bind and display the growing list of items.
Control the visibility of a loading indicator based on the component's state.
Apply Angular lifecycle hooks to set up and clean up scroll event listeners.
